speaker: alse_pinder
text: The cloth is slick, sir. It will not hold a bow.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Hold it by the corner, girl. A bow is how a parcel becomes a story on the road.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A cake of hard soap, and a skein of Coventry blue. Those two I have.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And the third.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She wrote, the kind with the two ends, as before. I have no before by me.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Two ends of what, sir?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Your wife asked you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She asked me in December. I am asking now, in this room.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am not your wife, and I am not a glossary. Ask her.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She has heard the comedy through the floor. She might have mercy on a man in a shop.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Four young men swear off women and keep it till dinner. That I believe. Your third thing I will not name.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I began, The winter hath been very full. I struck it. It tells her nothing she can buy.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It tells her you had a pen and a wish to be excused. Sixpence the parcel. Twopence if the question goes with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Gilbert will take it to the Bell. Thursday's carrier.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then let it look like a cheese. Cheeses arrive.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have tied it twice. There is no bow.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. Less handsome than I meant, and more likely to get there.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. Oiled cloth, and the knot at the side, where a horse will not chew it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: What do I write on the outside?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You write nothing. You cannot, and the direction is his work.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Anne Shakespeare, at Henley Street in Stratford. Gilbert knows the house.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the blot to go in the parcel too?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The blot stays here. The question I will copy clean.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: From London, the twelfth of January. Write the year as the law still has it. I am not your clerk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fifteen ninety-four, until Lady Day. I have not forgotten.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is a penny, and a finger short of the notch. You will eat before you write the fair line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three things. Two wrapped. One asked.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I should like to know the third, all the same.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: So should he. As I am a Christian woman, I shall not be the one to say it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the letter asks it, and Gilbert has the parcel for Thursday.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The knot is at the side, as you said.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then your brother can take it. I will not have it by the fire, where the cat tries string.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He will have it for Thursday. I am done with the wrapping.
